title: Gideon and the Room
author: Y. M. Okafor
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
